name: red-team-my-idea
description: Rigorously attack an idea, proposal, method, plan, or argument from multiple angles: scientific, engineering, operational, stakeholder, and deployment. Use when you want honest critique before committing to a direction, submitting a paper, proposing a system, or presenting to stakeholders. Triggers on: "red team this", "find the flaws in", "what's wrong with this idea", "steelman the opposition", "critique this proposal", "where does this break", "challenge this", "what am I missing", "devil's advocate".
